scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Freeze a formal isolated three-point lattice-temperature sensitivity in which only the thermal voltage used by the existing Scharfetter-Gummel electron-current expression changes.
fixed_variables: channel width = 60 um and length = 10 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
interface_4x mesh with fixed 0.25 um x spacing
top gate is primary and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
constant teaching mobility = 35.5 cm2/(V*s) at every temperature
background donor and ideal-ohmic contact electron density = 1e16 cm^-3
effective density of states, affinity, bandgap and permittivities remain unchanged and are not temperature laws
Poisson plus electron continuity with the existing Scharfetter-Gummel edge flux
bulk NTA, NGA, NTD and NGD = 0
no recombination, self-heating, ferroelectric polarization, or thermal boundary equation
prohibited_work_before_contract_pass: temperature-dependent mobility, density-of-states, bandgap, affinity, permittivity, contact, or trap law
simultaneous trap, contact, geometry, dielectric, bias, or mobility scan
M00, M01, SPICE, circuit-cell, layout, PEX, or HZO work
prohibited_claims_after_future_run: measured or fitted activation energy, mobility law, density of states, contact law, or thermal resistance
physical VTH, SS, Ioff, Ion, leakage, gm, or operating-temperature limit
self-heating, transient thermal, reliability, or circuit-temperature validation

temperature_model_contract.interpretation: This is a one-term numerical temperature sensitivity of the frozen teaching transport closure, not a complete physical IGZO temperature model.

sensitivity.interpretation: Three-point numerical sensitivity only; the endpoints are not measured environmental limits or a fitted process range.

inheritance.transport_source: config/tcad_t01_baseline.json with only physics.temperature_k and physics.thermal_voltage_v replaced per case
inheritance.bias_and_vth_gm_source: config/tcad_t02_c_bidirectional.json top_primary at fixed secondary gate = 0 V
inheritance.reason_prior_groups_are_zero: P5 attribution changes only lattice temperature in the declared transport term; completed P2 and P3 evidence is not combined into this isolated scan.

execution_order: create one fresh enabled dual-gate device for each temperature
set only the runtime temperature and thermal voltage before mesh/device creation
solve all-zero-bias Poisson initialization and coupled electron equilibrium
repeat the T02-C low-VDS ladder with both gates at 0 V
precondition the top primary gate from 0 V down to -0.5 V
sweep the exact 31-point top-gate grid upward with bottom gate fixed at 0 V
save the VTG=1.0 V state for each temperature
delete the device before creating the next temperature

constant_current_vth_proxy.name: constant_current_log_interpolation
constant_current_vth_proxy.interpolation: linear top-gate-voltage interpolation in log10(abs(drain current per unit width))

gm_proxy.name: central_difference_then_linear_interpolation
gm_proxy.definition: central-difference derivative of abs(drain current) versus top-gate voltage, linearly interpolated at VTH + 0.2 V

ss_proxy.name: fixed_current_window_ols
ss_proxy.endpoint_method: log-current interpolation to exact fixed-window endpoints
ss_proxy.fit: ordinary least squares of top-gate voltage versus log10(abs(drain current per unit width))

low_gate_current_proxy.name: fixed_lowest_gate_voltage_current
low_gate_current_proxy.definition: abs(drain current) at VTG=-0.5 V, VBG=0 V, and VDS=0.01 V

high_gate_current_proxy.name: fixed_highest_gate_voltage_current
high_gate_current_proxy.definition: abs(drain current) at VTG=1.0 V, VBG=0 V, and VDS=0.01 V

registered: The SS numerical proxy may increase as the explicit thermal voltage increases.
VTH, gm, low-gate current, high-gate current, potential and density directions are reported without a preregistered sign.
directional_hypotheses.failure_rule: A finite, converged, conserved and independently reproducible contrary or non-monotonic trend is retained and reported rather than converted into a stage failure.
directional_hypotheses.reason: Only V_t changes; the model intentionally omits calibrated IGZO mobility, density-of-states, contact, trap and band-parameter temperature laws.

electron_current_density.source_model: DEVSIM ElectronCurrent edge model projected by element_from_edge_model

required_failure_artifacts: all completed transfer rows and metrics
all completed state files and manifest entries
runner report with the exact failed acceptance gate
figures when enough persisted data exist
failure_retention.acceptance_change_rule: Any point, model-term, extraction-window or threshold change requires a new config revision, a recorded rationale, preservation of the failed contract/report, and a complete rerun.
prohibited_recovery: drop a temperature point after seeing its result
add an empirical temperature law after seeing the result
reuse a partially solved device as a replacement control

evidence_boundary.contract_allowed_claim: Static E3 checks may establish that the formal isolated 250/300/350 K P5 input contract is complete and internally consistent without running DEVSIM.
evidence_boundary.future_run_allowed_claim: Runner E2 plus independent persisted-evidence E3 PASS may close only the three-point V_t-only temperature sensitivity of the frozen 2D n-IGZO teaching model and thereby close numerical T03.
allowed_parameter_labels: sampled low-gate and high-gate current numerical proxies
prohibited_claims: experimental or calibrated IGZO temperature dependence
measured or fitted temperature-dependent mobility, DOS, contact, trap, bandgap, affinity, permittivity, activation energy, or thermal resistance
physical VTH, SS, leakage, Ioff, Ion, gm, operating range, reliability, or self-heating
compact-model, SPICE, circuit-cell, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence
complete T03 before both the formal runner and independent persisted-evidence checker pass
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only a committed contract PASS permits exactly one complete formal P5 run; only runner PASS permits the independent persisted-evidence check; only both PASS plus documentation may close numerical T03.
